'''Seocho-dong''' ({{Korean|hangul=서초동}}) is a ''[[Subdivisions of South Korea|dong]]'' (neighbourhood) of [[Seocho District]], [[Seoul]], South Korea. Seocho-dong is divided into 4 different dong which are Seocho 1-dong, 2-dong, 3-dong and 4-dong. The main street is [[Teheranno]].<ref name="encyber">{{cite web |url=http://www.encyber.com/search_w/ctdetail.php?masterno=732224&contentno=732224 |script-title=ko:서초동 (Seocho-dong 瑞草洞)|publisher=[[Doosan Encyclopedia]] |accessdate=2008-04-16 |language=Korean}}</ref> There is [[Gangnam Station]] in Seocho-dong, which is one of the biggest stations in Korea.
